prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective moving through Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a cloudy, foggy night sky. The camera advances steadily along a rugged, rocky path bordered by dense vegetation, capturing the dimly lit surroundings illuminated sporadically by the glow of a distant wildfire. As the viewer progresses, the fire becomes more prominent, its fierce orange flames consuming trees and shrubs, casting an eerie light that contrasts sharply with the dark, overcast sky. The camera pans slightly to reveal the expansive beach, where the rough terrain meets the calm sea, the horizon barely visible through the haze. The movement continues along the shoreline, the camera tilting occasionally to emphasize the dramatic interplay of firelight and shadow. The scene remains devoid of people, emphasizing the solitude and raw power of nature. The camera's steady forward motion and subtle shifts in angle provide a continuous, immersive view of this intense natural spectacle, highlighting the vivid oranges and reds of the fire against the muted grays and blacks of the night landscape.
